nonrecursive_seal.statement: The package candidate does NOT claim or embed its own future commit SHA. The committed activation payload keeps the freeze placeholder in evidence_commit_sha; the out-of-tree FINAL template is what binds the exact package candidate. Two SHAs, no self-reference.

evidence_tail_resolution.method: PROCEDURAL, via Git history — never self-embedded.
commands: git log --oneline 58b36206669a27d1ce6171f0f3149721c24f35c7..HEAD    # exactly one evidence-only commit
evidence_tail_resolution.why: A commit cannot contain its own hash. The tail is therefore resolved by walking history from the frozen package candidate, not by writing a SHA into the object that would produce it.
